tools.name: list_rbz_publications
tools.title: List RBZ rate publications
tools.description: List every Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe daily exchange-rate PDF published in a given month, by probing the deterministic RBZ URL pattern for each weekday. Returns the ISO date and direct PDF URL for each publication found.

tools.name: get_latest_rbz_publication
tools.title: Get latest RBZ rate publication
tools.description: Find the most recent Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe daily exchange-rate PDF that has been published on or before an optional target date. Skips weekends automatically (RBZ does not publish on Saturdays or Sundays) and walks back up to 10 weekdays to find the newest available PDF. Returns the ISO date and direct PDF URL.

on_or_before.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (UTC). The search starts from this date and walks backwards to the most recent weekday with a published PDF.
